name: flinttrade-monorepo
//: brace-expansion overrides (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg, advisory range <=5.0.7): the selectors below
cover EVERY vulnerable range, not just the ones the tree happens to resolve today, so a future
transitive copy cannot silently reintroduce the flaw behind the audit allowlist entry.
Patched releases per major line: 2.1.3 (dist-tag maintenance-v2), 3.0.5 (maintenance-v3),
5.0.8 (latest). 1.x has no patched release of its own, so it is pulled onto 2.1.3, which keeps
the callable CommonJS default export that minimatch 3.x/5.x/9.x require.
The 4.x line is the exception: npm publishes only 4.0.0 and 4.0.1, both inside the advisory
range, and there is no maintenance-v4 dist-tag - no patched 4.x exists. It is therefore mapped
to 3.0.5, the newest patched release that keeps 4.x's API: 3.x and 4.x are both ESM-only with
the same `export default expandTop` shape (3.x additionally accepts an options argument), and
the only 3.0.4 -> 4.0.1 change is an internal split/join -> regex refactor. 5.0.8 is NOT usable
there: 5.x replaced the default export with a named `expand`.
Verify a target exists before pinning to it: npm view brace-expansion@<version> version
